en:
<CLT=cltMIND>I don't even remember how I
got back to my room.

<CLT=cltMIND>But before I knew it, I felt my
body in the bed, numb.
<CLT=cltMIND>I didn't want to sleep.

<CLT=cltMIND>I just wanted to run away from the
despair. But the sleep came anyway.

Did you know that when you talk to someone on
a cell phone, you're not hearing their real voice?

Their voice is converted to synthetic sound
while you're both communicating.

By breaking down their voice into various
waveform patterns...

The phone reassembles those patterns to
recreate characteristics of the speaker's voice.

This reduces the amount of voice data that
needs to be sent to make the call possible.

Also, you know how shaved ice has flavored
syrups such as strawberry, melon, and lemon?

They're all the same flavor. The only difference
is the aroma and the food coloring dye.

Do you think these facts are lies?
Do you deny that these facts are lies?

Puhuhu. What would the world be like if
all lies were denied outright?

I bet it would be a very lonesome world.
Lies are what make the world go 'round.

<CLT=cltMIND>Monokuma must not be here anymore.
There's no point to morning announcements now.
<CLT=cltMIND>So...it's really over.

<CLT=cltMIND>There's no point to this
killing game anymore.

<CLT=cltMIND>Because there's no reason
to go outside.
<CLT=cltMIND>There's no reason...to keep living.
<CLT=cltMIND>There's no reason to live.

<CLT=cltMIND>There's no reason to live. There's no
reason to live. There's no reason to live.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is an epilogue.
All that's left...is to take up time.
<CLT=cltMIND>...What a boring story.
<CLT=cltMIND>There's nothing I can do anymore.
<CLT=cltMIND>...
<CLT=cltMIND>...
<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder...
<CLT=cltMIND>what everyone else is doing...
<CLT=cltMIND>...
<CLT=cltMIND>...
<CLT=cltMIND>...

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder...
what Kaito is doing...

That's right...
I wonder if...Kaito is okay...?
<CLT=cltMIND>...
<CLT=cltMIND>It's no use.

<CLT=cltMIND>My mind isn't...working...
And my body...
<CLT=cltMIND>...

If you're searching for the meaning of life,
you're already doing it wrong.

Your life doesn't need a <CLT=cltSTRONG>meaning<CLT=typeNORMAL>.
It just needs a <CLT=cltSTRONG>purpose<CLT=typeNORMAL>.

In other words, you just need something
to live for.

You can live for spending time with loved
ones, or chasing dreams...

You can even live for eating delicious food,
or playing games...

Most people can get by as long as they have
something to live for.

If you say Danganronpa is your reason to live,
I couldn't be happier.

Puhuhu... It's been a real pleasure doing
business with you.
<CLT=cltMIND>...
<CLT=cltMIND>It's morning...
<CLT=cltMIND>...
<CLT=cltMIND>How long have I been like this...?

<CLT=cltMIND>I should...get up...
Or I might not ever get up again.
<CLT=cltMIND>I...
<CLT=cltMIND>...

<CLT=cltMIND>I don't care.
If I...just kill my—
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>*ding dong...ding dong!*
What?

<CLT=cltMIND>My body reacted reflexively
as I heard the doorbell.

<CLT=cltMIND>Somewhat surprised that I even managed
to get out of bed, I went to the door.
Who could it be...?
<CLT=cltMIND>Who could it be...?
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?

<CLT=cltMIND>On my feet for the first time in a long
while, I walked uneasily to the door.
<CLT=cltMIND>I slowly opened it, and...
You look terrible...
M-Maki?

Go take a shower or something.
Anything to help your face.
I'll be in the dining hall with everyone else.
...Everyone?
...I'll be waiting, so hurry up.
<CLT=cltMIND>Maki spoke curtly and left.
<CLT=cltMIND>Everyone is waiting in the dining hall?
I...guess I should go.

<CLT=cltMIND>I hurried and took a hot shower,
then left my room.

<CLT=cltMIND>How many more nights do I have to
sleep in this bed? I'm so...sick of it!

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a pretty big light.
It lights the room well...

<CLT=cltMIND>My closet is filled with
uniforms exactly like mine...

<CLT=cltMIND>They went through all this just for a
killing game? What is their objective...?
